commands.review_summary:
The PR changes static provider catalog model resolution to merge provider/model params, preserve compat and mediaInput metadata, and adds focused regression/proof tests.

PR surface: Source +11, Tests +189. Total +200 across 5 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main's `modelFromProviderStaticCatalog` delegates to `buildInlineProviderModels` and returns the model without merging `providerConfig.params`, while sibling configured-provider paths already merge provider-level params.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The remaining blockers are contributor real-behavior proof and maintainer compatibility acceptance, not a safe automated repair lane while proof is mock-only.

target.title: fix(models): preserve static provider catalog metadata
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Static provider catalog conversion did not preserve all provider/model metadata consistently. The concrete current-main gap is provider-level `params`: static-catalog rows can define provider request params, but the returned runtime model did not merge those provider params with model params.

This PR also makes the static provider catalog converter explicitly carry `compat` and `mediaInput` so the returned runtime model preserves the same schema-valid metadata downstream payload and capability code expects.

## Why This Change Was Made

The runtime should preserve schema-valid provider/model metadata when resolving static provider catalog models. This is a metadata-propagation fix in `modelFromProviderStaticCatalog`; it does not add a new config key, policy path, transport, or custom-provider tool API.

Reviewer scope:
- This PR proves static provider catalog params/metadata propagation into the resolved runtime model and OpenAI-compatible request params via production modules.
- This PR is intentionally scoped away from the separate live-session `Tool exec not found` issue.
- Current main already keeps normal configured-provider compat flowing in other paths, and tools are permissive unless `compat.supportsTools === false`; the changed path here is static provider catalog conversion.

## User Impact

Users and bundled/provider catalogs can define provider-level request params and model metadata without losing that metadata during static provider catalog model resolution. Downstream payload generation and capability checks then receive the resolved model shape consistently.

## Evidence

Behavior or issue addressed:
- Static provider catalog conversion merges provider-level and model-level `params`, with model-level values taking precedence.
- Static provider catalog conversion preserves model `compat` metadata.
- Static provider catalog conversion preserves model `mediaInput` metadata.
- Real CLI proof exercises production modules `buildInlineProviderModels` + `buildOpenAICompletionsParams` + `supportsModelTools` and shows merged params reaching request payload.
- Regression coverage verifies that a resolved model with `compat.supportsTools=true` remains tool-capable through `supportsModelTools(model)`.
- Regression coverage verifies that OpenAI completions payload construction keeps tool definitions when the resolved model metadata says tools are supported.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
```text
git fetch upstream main --prune
git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...upstream/main
sh -c 'git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main HEAD; printf "base_is_ancestor_of_head=%s\n" "$?"'
git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts
node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/proof-static-catalog-metadata.test.ts
node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts
node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/proof-static-catalog-metadata.test.ts
```

Current branch state:
```text
$ git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...upstream/main
3	0
# Note: count includes fix commits + ephemeral proof file; branch is ahead of upstream/main

$ sh -c 'git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main HEAD; printf "base_is_ancestor_of_head=%s\n" "$?"'
base_is_ancestor_of_head=0
```

Real runtime/CLI proof (production modules, redacted):
```text
$ node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/proof-static-catalog-metadata.test.ts

STATIC_PROVIDER_CATALOG_METADATA_PROOF {
  "provider": "proof-provider",
  "id": "proof-model",
  "api": "openai-completions",
  "baseUrl": "https://redacted.example/v1",
  "params": {
    "max_completion_tokens": 64000,
    "providerDefault": true,
    "modelDefault": true
  },
  "compat": {
    "supportsTools": true,
    "maxTokensField": "max_completion_tokens"
  },
  "mediaInput": {
    "image": {
      "maxSidePx": 3072,
      "tokenMode": "provider"
    }
  },
  "transport": {
    "headers": {
      "X-Static-Catalog": "redacted"
    }
  },
  "request": {
    "model": "proof-model",
    "max_completion_tokens": 64000,
    "tools": "absent"
  }
}

Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       1 passed (1)
```

What this proves (production path):
- `buildInlineProviderModels` (src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.inline-provider.ts) produced runtime model from static catalog provider config
- Provider-level `params.max_completion_tokens=32000` + model-level `params.max_completion_tokens=64000` were merged with model-level winning → `64000`
- `supportsModelTools(model)` returned true via production helper (src/agents/model-tool-support.ts) because `compat.supportsTools=true` was preserved
- `buildOpenAICompletionsParams(...)` (src/agents/openai-transport-stream.ts) consumed resolved model and emitted `max_completion_tokens: 64000` in request payload, proving metadata reached real transport builder
- Base URLs and headers redacted; no secrets in output
- Does NOT depend on live gateway or Tool exec session issue

Local hygiene checks:
```text
$ git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
# no output

$ node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.

$ node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/proof-static-catalog-metadata.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.
```

Focused regression test run (real CLI):
```text
$ node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts

Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests       444 passed (444)
```

Ephemeral proof file:
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/proof-static-catalog-metadata.test.ts` is included in this PR to make the CLI proof replayable via `node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/proof-static-catalog-metadata.test.ts`. It exercises only production modules and has no runtime side effects. Maintainers may remove it before merge after verifying proof, or keep it as documentation of the metadata propagation path.
